scene: A phone vlog from the seats of a full indoor basketball arena before the game. A big, warm crowd murmur all round.
context: A ten-second comedy moment played by two close friends on a sports trip. It must sound like two real people talking, quick and natural, never like an advert or a narrator. LUNA, about 25, is cheerful, quick and sure of herself; to her everything is good news. TIMO, about 30, is slow, dry and proud; he never raises his voice. They answer each other fast.
lines: [bright, over the crowd, to the camera, a dare] Basketball. One sentence.
[unhurried, exact, to the camera] Both teams score a hundred times, and it's settled in the last four seconds, which take half an hour.
[turning to him, pleased with herself] That was two sentences.
[at once, flat, to her] There was a comma.

L.audio_profile: A cheerful woman of 25 with a bright, warm, quick voice; natural and unpolished, like a friend filming a vlog.

T.audio_profile: A tall, dry man of 30 with a low, casual voice; slow, proud, deadpan; he never raises his voice.
